q: Several recent publications have raised concerns for AKI in high potency station, particularly if there is a predisposition. 94 This coincides with the SHARP study that highlighted the safety and efficacy of simvastatin plus ezetimibe in ESRD. 67 Exploring a wider role for vytorin is a consideration to reduce high-dose statins in selected cases.

2015 August 5, P Iyngkaran, M Thomas, “Bedside–to-Bench Translational Research for Chronic Heart Failure: Creating an Agenda for Clients Who Do Not Meet Trial Enrollment Criteria”, in Clinical Medicin
